recommendation.reason: The smallest complete ordinary-enemy shape has SelectorTrigger + one RangedAttack + presentation emitter, no Buffs or extra actions, both owner modes already compiled. The source timing/projectiles are reusable; EnemySkill scheduling and SP are still missing.
recommendation.evidenceBoundary: Source SP cost is known; SP acquisition timing and normal-attack arbitration must be bound as one public contract, not inferred merely from spCost=2. This is one encounter member, not all 16.
recommendation.extensionBoundary: The other RangedAttack member needs a tag-excluding selector, loaded stun Buff and Boss compatibility. Do not promote it with the no-Buff subset.
recommendation.rebornConclusion: No simple complete class among the five encounter members. Three require named handlers; the closest no-handler candidate still has ModifySp then SwitchMode(restartFSM=true); the other needs retained yin/yang Buff creation and an uncompiled target mode.
